task.title: Adding and Configuring OnCall Lists
task.shortdesc: This topic describes how to add and configure the OnCallLists. The lists contains people designated to be on-call during a particular time period. When an alarm is raised in your station, the people configured as per set schedules in the active OnCallLists are notified about the alarm.

taskbody.prereq: Workbench is open and you are connected to the station.

step.cmd: To add the new list, click New, select On Call List and click OK.
In the New window, type the new Name or use the default name and click OK.You can see the added On Call Lists in the On Call List Manager view.
To edit the list, select the list from the existing On Call Lists, click Edit, type the new name and click OK.
Repeat the steps 1, 2, and 3 to add more On Call Lists.

example.p: Because OnCallLists are selected based on predefined schedules, it is advisable to define them according to specific days and time ranges to ensure timely and relevant notifications. For example, you might create separate OnCallLists such as Day Shift, Night Shift, and Weekends to align with your operational coverage needs.
